=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .claude/commands/claude-issue-pickup.md | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The pickup command's step 1 multi-page read is bounded at 5 pages of 100, so on an account with more than 500 enabled triggers the listing is incomplete at the end of step 1; `start`, `stop`, `catch-up`, and `wake` do not fail safe when the pickup trigger is beyond those pages.
  WHY: `start` or catch-up can create duplicate triggers, `stop` can leave a trigger active, and `wake` can fail its sanity check spuriously; step 3b already handles the incomplete listing safely via `load_trigger_pages`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- .claude/commands/claude-issue-pickup.md | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Lines 32-40 and 84. Step 1 stops after five pages, but these branches use the pages read without checking whether the fifth page still has `has_more`.
  WHY: With more than 500 enabled triggers, the pickup’s own trigger can fall beyond the pages read, causing `start` to create another pickup, wake to report “not the active pickup” and exit, `stop` to leave triggers active, or catch-up to schedule a duplicate.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- .claude/commands/claude-issue-pickup.md | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Step 1 (lines 32-35) reads at most 5 `list_triggers` pages and stops even when page 5 still has `has_more`; `start`, `stop`, wake, and catch-up then treat the partial listing as authoritative.
  WHY: With more than 500 enabled Routines, `start` or catch-up can create a duplicate, `stop` can leave active triggers behind, and an hourly wake can misidentify itself as stale and stop draining the queue; step 3b's `scan` path already handles incomplete listings safely.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
